column1: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
I, hereby declare that out of the powers and functions vested in me in my capacity as the Minister of Sports and Youth
Affairs of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka powers and functions specified in the following schedule are
delegated to the State Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs Duminda Dissanayake in terms of provisions of the Article
44(5) of the constitution and he has the opportunity of inquiring, mediating and coordinating all functions coming within
the scope of work of this Ministry.
